heroHeadline: Saudi Arabia Pushes Multilateral Navigation Security Framework as Hormuz Crisis Enters Week 13
heroSubtitle: Riyadh called for a 'comprehensive' regional navigation security framework at a multilateral forum Sep 27, signaling intent to broaden protections for maritime food supply routes; Saudi urgency reflects growing pressure on Hormuz-dependent grain and oil shipping corridors after 87 days of disruption
